Subtitle: Wood Fiber Mulch with Dairy Compost
Brief Overview: Premium wood fiber mulch enhanced with Simon's Gold dairy compost. Nature's Blanket suppresses weeds, retains moisture, and slowly feeds the soil as it breaks down, giving landscapes a clean, finished look.
Key Features/benefits: Weed suppression, moisture retention, slow-release soil feeding, attractive natural appearance.
Target audience: Landscapers, HOA Maintenance, Nurseries, Commercial Properties, Homeowners
Recommended Uses: Landscape mulching, tree rings, garden bed topdressing, pathway covering
Gardener Usage Instructions: Apply 2-3 inches of mulch around plants, trees, and garden beds. Keep mulch a few inches away from plant stems and tree trunks.

Subtitle: Wood Fiber Mulch with Dairy Compost & Worm Castings
Brief Overview: The upgraded version of Nature's Blanket, enhanced with both dairy compost and worm castings. Delivers even richer soil biology and nutrition as it decomposes, for landscapes that truly thrive.
Key Features/benefits: Enhanced with worm castings for superior biology, premium soil feeding, maximum moisture retention.
Target audience: Landscapers, Premium Properties, Nurseries, Estate Gardens, Golf Courses
Recommended Uses: Premium landscape mulching, high-end commercial properties, garden showcase areas
Gardener Usage Instructions: Apply 2-3 inches around plants and beds. This premium blend feeds the soil more actively as it breaks down.
